translations.en.yusufali: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah hari Kiamat itu?

transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

translations.en.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
translations.en.pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
translations.en.yusufali: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari itu manusia adalah seperti anai-anai yang bertebaran,

transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
translations.en.pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
translations.id.indonesian: dan gunung-gunung adalah seperti bulu yang dihambur-hamburkan.

translations.en.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
translations.en.pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
translations.en.yusufali: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun orang-orang yang berat timbangan (kebaikan)nya,

translations.en.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.
translations.en.pickthall: He will live a pleasant life.
translations.en.yusufali: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
translations.id.indonesian: maka dia berada dalam kehidupan yang memuaskan.

transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

translations.en.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light,
translations.en.yusufali: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun orang-orang yang ringan timbangan (kebaikan)nya,

translations.en.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.
translations.en.pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
translations.en.yusufali: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
translations.id.indonesian: maka tempat kembalinya adalah neraka Hawiyah.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what this is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah neraka Hawiyah itu?

translations.en.sahih: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
